summary: Frontend-only verification of newly added UI features. All 5 review items PASSED. (1) /auth renders the new purple 'g' logo Image asset (64x64, src=/assets/.../images/logo-g.png). (2) /ride/[id] during 'searching' shows the new requested-route summary box above offer cards with pickup -> destination (verified 'Lake Eola Park' -> 'Orlando Intl Airport (MCO)' rendered above 5 offer cards). (3) Customer home gracefully falls back to default Orlando pickup 'Lake Eola Park' when web geolocation is denied (no crash, map renders). (4) /driver-trip/[id]: 4-min cancel timer renders 'Cancel available in 4:00' and counts down (saw 3:54 later); cancel text styled in muted/disabled color; nav banner meta line shows 'To pickup · 3.6 mi · 13 min · Arrive 7:12 AM' during accepted and 'To destination · 0.8 mi · 5 min · Arrive 7:05 AM' during in_progress; Complete Trip / Chat / Call gating code-verified (Pressable disabled + lockHint text rendered when remMi > 1) — could not catch active lock at runtime because the simulated 'Lake Eola -> Amway Center' trip is only 0.7 mi (remMi < 1, so controls correctly unlocked); completed-screen code path renders only checkmark + fare + 'Back to Driving' (no chat/call) per /app/frontend/app/driver-trip/[id].tsx lines 139-148. (5) 3D tilt map renders during navigation with no crash; blue route line + animated car puck visible; pitch=55 confirmed in MapView.web.tsx lines 188/398. End-to-end flow: customer signup -> place picker -> Find Rides -> /ride/[id] searching with route box + offers -> driver signup -> Go Online -> Set Fare -> Submit Bid -> auto-accept ~5s -> /driver-trip/[id] -> advance accepted -> arrived -> in_progress. No red-screen errors. Console warnings unchanged from iteration_1 (shadow*, pointerEvents) — already known cosmetic items.
